name: Polls
description: Encuestas al estilo WP-Polls: crea encuestas con opciones, controla cuándo se muestran los resultados y publícalas en cualquier página con el bloque Polls del editor visual (votación + barras de resultados animadas).
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Run the plugin's own compiled interface in the browser: its admin page and its Verso block (in the editor and on public pages). Without it the host does not serve these bundles and that interface does not load.
Read polls and aggregate vote counts from the plugin's own wjp_polls_ tables.
Create the polls/votes tables and insert/update polls and votes.
Admin CRUD routes plus the public poll/vote endpoints the Puck block consumes.
Add the 'Encuestas' entry to the admin sidebar.
